master.title: Russian Defense Minister Shoigu inspects Hmeimim airbase in Syria, meets with al-Assad in Damascus
master.content:
Shoigu inspects Hmeimim airbase in Syria - Russian Defense Ministry

MOSCOW. Feb 15 (Interfax) - Russian Defense Minister Sergei Shoigu on Tuesday inspected the Russian airbase in Syria's Hmeimim, the Russian Defense Ministry said in a statement on Tuesday.

"While visiting the airbase's command post, Gen. Sergei Shoigu listened to a report compiled by Lieu. Gen. Berdnikov, the commander of the Russian taskforce in Syria, on the current situation and actions being taken jointly with Syrian armed forces to fight the remnants of international terrorists and to provide humanitarian aid to the local population," the Defense Ministry said.

Shoigu meets with al-Assad in Damascus

MOSCOW. Feb 15 (Interfax) - Russia's Defense Minister Sergei Shoigu has visited Damascus, where he met Syrian President Bashar al-Assad, the defense ministry stated on Tuesday.

"At the behest of Russian President Vladimir Putin, the Russian defense minister, Army General Sergei Shoigu, made a working trip to Damascus, where he was received by the president of Syria, Bashar al-Assad," the statement said.

Shoigu informed al-Assad of the current Russian naval exercise in the East Mediterranean, the ministry said.

"At the meeting, Sergei Shoigu and Bashar al-Assad discussed various issues concerning their countries' military-technical cooperation as part of the joint fight against remaining international terrorists and also certain aspects of Russia's humanitarian assistance to the Syrian population affected by punitive U.S. and Western sanctions," the ministry said.

Earlier on Tuesday, Shoigu inspected Russian bases at Syria's Hmeimim and Tartus. The minister watched the Russian naval exercise in the Mediterranean Sea, involving more than 15 warships and over 30 aircraft.

Over 15 naval ships taking part in Russian Navy exercise in Mediterranean

MOSCOW. Feb 15 (Interfax) - Over 15 naval ships and more than 30 aircraft are involved in a Russian Navy exercise in the Mediterranean Sea, the Russian Defense Ministry said.

"More than 15 naval ships of the Pacific, Northern and Black Sea Fleets, in particular, the Varyag and Marshal Ustinov missile cruisers and the Admiral Kasatonov and Admiral Grigorovich frigates, the Admiral Tributs and Vice Admiral Kulakov large anti-submarine ships, and support vessels, as well as more than 30 aircraft of the Russian Aerospace Forces are involved in an exercise in the Mediterranean Sea," the Defense Ministry said.

Navy Commander Nikolai Yevmenov reported to Defense Minister Sergei Shoigu "on the performance of joint training and combat exercises by Russian ships and aircraft of the Russian Aerospace Forces in defeating mock enemy groups of ships," the ministry said.

Additionally, the exercise involved firing practice at naval and air targets using artillery and anti-submarine weapons, the Defense Ministry said.
